scope: Just-in-time owner UI creates fresh execution assignment after setup, preserving existing expiry, durable duplicate prevention and all backend authority.
riskAnalysis: No grant lifetime extension or new execution authorization. New UI action can only create an existing bounded task; backend preparation remains authoritative. Exact release lock regenerated from actual sources.

threatModel.assets: Task identity, source binding, consumed approvals, durable creation key, cleanup and historical evidence.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Cached UI configuration is a convenience prerequisite; server owner/source/task/sequence checks remain authoritative.
threatModel.abuseCases: Double clicks, lost creation acknowledgement, foreign runtime readback, stale saved approval and failure to persist pending draft.
threatModel.mitigations: Existing durable idempotency journal before dispatch, pending reentry denial, exact scope fence and persisted readback; no automatic activation or deadline extension.

rollback: Revert successor source on feature branch if necessary, preserving all original financial and audit evidence and keeping paid disabled. Do not revive previous grants.
